## Scope

Describe the CAP, Provider / Access Path, or platform contract changed. Link the
tracking Issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The measurable outcomes for this change are listed here.
- [ ] Native and QVeris identities remain separate where applicable.
- [ ] No aggregate score or global Provider ranking is introduced.

## Evidence and disclosure

List evidence digests or real-run artifacts, source licenses, redactions, conflicts
of interest, and known limitations. Do not include credentials or private raw data.

## Validation

- [ ] Changed-area tests
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run mypy src`
- [ ] Relevant real E2E or release replay
